{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Ghost| type2=Poison| trainername=Morty| pokemonname=Gengar| jtrainername=マツバ| jpokemonname=ゲンガー| tmtrainername=Matsuba| tmpokemonname=Gangar| image=[[File:Morty Gengar.png|220px]] | caption=Morty’s Gengar| location=[[Johto]] | epnum=EP181| epname=A Ghost of a Chance| gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in the games}}| ability={{a|Levitate}}{{tt|*|Confirmed in the games only}}| prevonum=094| noevo=incap| current=[[Party|With Morty]]| java1=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]| enva1=[[Ted Lewis|Ed Paul]]| }} '''Morty's Gengar''' (Japanese: '''マツバのゲンガー''' ''Matsuba's Gangar'') is [[Morty]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. It is [[Walking Pokémon|always seen outside of its Poké Ball]]. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== ====={{aniseries|GS}}===== [[File:Morty and Gengar.png|thumb|left|220px|Gengar and Morty]] Gengar first appeared in ''[[EP181|A Ghost of a Chance]]'' in the [[Burned Tower]], which {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} mistook for the [[Ecruteak Gym]]. When {{AP|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Misty|Togepi}} disappeared into a small hole within the Burned Tower, Morty had Gengar round up the {{p|Gastly}} and {{p|Haunter}} living in the tower in order to find the two. When {{TRT}} ran off with Pikachu and Togepi, Gengar appeared and tripped them with {{m|Lick}}. After it had knocked Pikachu and Togepi out of Team Rocket's grasp, the trio sent out their {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}} to battle Gengar. However, they were easily defeated by Gengar's powerful {{m|Shadow Ball}}. In ''[[EP182|From Ghost to Ghost]]'', Gengar demonstrated its {{m|Confuse Ray}} to a group of Trainers whom Morty was teaching. During the Gym battle with Ash, Morty sent Gengar out as his last Pokémon. Like the rest of Morty's team, Gengar put its ability to turn invisible to use against Noctowl, being also able to attack it while invisible to keep it from using {{m|Foresight}}. Eventually, Ash was able to come up with a plan and had Noctowl use {{m|Confusion}} everywhere, forcing Gengar to turn visible. This allowed Noctowl to use Foresight on it and then defeat it with {{m|Tackle}}, earning Ash the {{badge|Fog}}. Gengar reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP184|All That Glitters!]]'', when Ash was recalling the time he received the first four badges of Johto. In ''[[EP227|For Ho-Oh the Bells Toll!]]'', Morty instructed Gengar to find the stolen [[Clear Bell|Crystal Bells]]. When [[Ecruteak City]] was under attack by angry {{type|Bug}} Pokémon and {{p|Gligar}}, Morty had Gengar use Confuse Ray on a group of {{p|Parasect}}. ====={{aniseries|DP}}===== Gengar reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]'', where it was seen alongside [[Whitney's Miltank]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== Gengar is usually outside its Poké Ball and hiding in the shadows, though it appears when needed. It has mischievous nature and enjoys pulling pranks on people, especially those who enter the [[Burned Tower]]. However, Gengar has been helpful, especially with cases involving Pokémon or items stolen by {{TRT}}. It has the ability to become invisible and reappear before its opponent notices. However, {{Ash}} overcame this by having his {{AP|Noctowl}} use {{m|Confusion}} on the whole gym. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ghost|poison|Morty Gengar {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Lick|1=Night Shade|2=Shadow Ball|3=Confuse Ray}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Lick|1=Night Shade|2=Shadow Ball|3=Confuse Ray}}}} {{anmov|ghost|Lick|EP181|A Ghost of a Chance}} {{anmov|ghost|Night Shade|EP181|A Ghost of a Chance}} {{anmov|ghost|Shadow Ball|EP181|A Ghost of a Chance}} {{anmov|ghost|Confuse Ray|EP182|From Ghost to Ghost}} {{anmov/f|poison}} ===Pokémon Evolutions=== [[File:Morty Evolutions.png|thumb|250px|Morty's Gengar in [[Pokémon Evolutions]]]] Gengar appeared in ''[[PE07|The Show]]'', watching the [[Kimono Girl]]s perform a show alongside [[Morty]]. {{color2|000|Game Freak}} website |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys=== [[File:Morty Gengar Golden Boys.png|thumb|180px|Gengar in Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] Gengar appeared in ''[[GB13|A Promise Given to Miltank]]'', where Morty called it out to stop a {{p|Spearow}} from stealing the satchel that contained {{Berries}} collected by Gold. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ghost|poison|Morty Gengar Mean Look 1 Golden Boys.png|Using Mean Look}} {{anmov|normal|Mean Look|GB13|A Promise Given to Miltank}} {{anmov/f|poison}} ===Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure=== [[File:Morty Gengar JBA.png|thumb|left|200px|Gengar in Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure]] Gengar appeared in [[JBA2]]. Morty sent it out alongside his {{p|Haunter}} to battle [[Jō's Totodile]] in the [[Burned Tower]]. After Haunter was defeated, Gengar went up next. Despite putting up a great fight, Gengar was defeated.
